career_ladder.note: Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) operate under the sponsorship of nationalized commercial banks and NABARD supervision to provide institutional rural credit, agricultural financing, and priority sector banking across rural and semi-urban districts. Officers progress from Scale I through Scale III and senior management executive roles.

exam_scheme.note: The IBPS CRP for RRBs recruits for both Group 'A' Officers (Scale I, II & III) and Group 'B' Office Assistants (Multipurpose). For Officer Scale I, selection consists of Preliminary, Main Examination, and Personal Interview. For Office Assistant (Multipurpose), there is no interview; selection is determined 100% on Main Examination merit. Objective tests carry 1/4th (0.25 marks) negative marking.

papers.paper_name: Interview Board (Mains score 80% weightage + Interview 20% weightage = 100 aggregate merit)

financial_package.pay_source_label: 12th Bipartite Settlement parity for Regional Rural Banks per DFS / NABARD guidelines (Officer Scale I entry basic ₹48,480)
financial_package.estimate_note: Starting basic pay is ₹48,480 for Officer Scale I (and ₹24,050 for Office Assistant Multipurpose). Initial gross monthly pay for Scale I officers ranges from ₹65,000 to ₹82,000 depending on rural/semi-urban allowances, House Rent Allowance (7% to 9%), Special Allowance, and Dearness Allowance. Deductions include NPS and professional tax.
official_perks: House Rent Allowance or Bank leased accommodation in district headquarters / rural centers
Special Allowance and Dearness Allowance per Bipartite settlement terms
Medical aid and hospitalization coverage for officer and family per RRB regulations
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) / Home Town travel benefits
Concessional staff loans for housing and vehicle purchase per RRB rules
Contributory Pension benefits under National Pension System (NPS)

competition_benchmarks.note: IBPS CRP RRBs is one of the highest-volume rural recruitments in India, filling thousands of officer and office assistant vacancies across 43 Regional Rural Banks nationwide.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 128 (calculated: applicants ÷ notified vacancies across all posts)
years.source_label: IBPS — CRP RRBs XIII Detailed Notification (Officer Scale I: 3,583; Office Assistant: 5,585; Scale II/III: 1,145)
